maker.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2, citing Epson, TM-T20III Technical Reference Guide, https://files.support.epson.com/pdf/pos/bulk/tm-t20iii_trg_en_reva.pdf

model.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2, citing Jordan Computers, https://jordancomputers.com/en/tm-t20iii-012-en; Epson, TM-T20III Technical Reference Guide, https://files.support.epson.com/pdf/pos/bulk/tm-t20iii_trg_en_reva.pdf

firmware_qualified.source: Not stated by any seed source: no firmware range is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2 and the documents it cites). The gate records the range it qualified (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a, §6b.5).

transport.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2, citing Epson, TM-T20III Technical Reference Guide, https://files.support.epson.com/pdf/pos/bulk/tm-t20iii_trg_en_reva.pdf: “printing data and printer status via (bidirectional) direct socket communication”; TCP 9100 first, per ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a

paper_mm.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2, citing Epson, TM-T20III Technical Reference Guide, https://files.support.epson.com/pdf/pos/bulk/tm-t20iii_trg_en_reva.pdf: “prints 72 mm = 576 dots at 203 dpi”, on 80 mm paper

dot_width.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2, citing Epson, TM-T20III Technical Reference Guide, https://files.support.epson.com/pdf/pos/bulk/tm-t20iii_trg_en_reva.pdf: “prints 72 mm = 576 dots at 203 dpi”

raster_command.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2, citing Epson, ESC/POS reference, GS v 0, https://download4.epson.biz/sec_pubs/pos/reference_en/escpos/gs_lv_0.html: “One raster command carries at most 2303 dot rows on the TM-T20III, TM-T20IV and TM-m30III”. Epson marks GS v 0 obsolete and recommends GS ( L, whose device limit no seed source states, so the profile names the command whose limit is sourced

raster_max_rows.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2, citing Epson, ESC/POS reference, GS v 0, https://download4.epson.biz/sec_pubs/pos/reference_en/escpos/gs_lv_0.html: “One raster command carries at most 2303 dot rows on the TM-T20III, TM-T20IV and TM-m30III”

code_pages.source: Not stated by any seed source: no code page is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2 and the documents it cites). Receipts print as raster; code pages serve only the §2.1 text fallback (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6b.2).

auto_cutter.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2, citing Epson, TM-T20III Technical Reference Guide, https://files.support.epson.com/pdf/pos/bulk/tm-t20iii_trg_en_reva.pdf: “has an auto-cutter and a 6-pin drawer port supplying 24 V on pin 4”

cut_command.source: Not stated by any seed source: an auto-cutter is named at most, never which GS V cut it honours (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2 and the documents it cites). 1.7.4's partial cut is a baseline, not this device's fact (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a).

cut_feed_rows.source: Not stated by any seed source: no feed before the cut is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2 and the documents it cites). It is measured on the device: crate::escpos records why no feed is emitted yet (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6b.5).

status_protocol.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2, citing Epson, TM-T20III Technical Reference Guide, https://files.support.epson.com/pdf/pos/bulk/tm-t20iii_trg_en_reva.pdf: “printing data and printer status via (bidirectional) direct socket communication”; DLE EOT is the real-time status request §4.2 requires over Ethernet

drawer_port_volts.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2, citing Epson, TM-T20III Technical Reference Guide, https://files.support.epson.com/pdf/pos/bulk/tm-t20iii_trg_en_reva.pdf: “has an auto-cutter and a 6-pin drawer port supplying 24 V on pin 4”

drawer_pulse.source: Not stated by any seed source: no pin or timing is named (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.2 and the documents it cites). The pin is the drawer's property and the timings its solenoid's (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.5; ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a).

supports_raster_arabic.source: A qualification result rather than a datasheet fact: nobody has printed the Arabic goldens on this device (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a; milestone 5.8.3).
